title: Reclassifications for transactions coded against the mapping rules
prompt: Review transactions coded to the wrong department or account based on approved mapping rules and propose reclassifications.

setup.q: Where are the approved coding rules (vendor to account, vendor to department, keyword rules) and who approved them?

inputs.name: Transactions for the month with account and department
Mapping workbook (vendor and keyword to account and department)

steps: read the period-lock state; a closed period is a question, not a proposal
pull the month's transactions with account and department, and Dime's categorization rules; read the standing mapping workbook
run coding_consistency: each transaction against the rule that applies to its vendor or description
propose one bulk categorization per target account and department: tier A where a deterministic rule names the target, tier B where the target is a judgement
write the workbook with the rule cited for every reclass

done.text: Every exception row cites the transaction id and the rule it fails
reclass-proposals.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every proposal names a route the desk may call and carries no unbalanced entry
Every reclass cites its rule; no transaction without a rule is reclassed at tier A; closed periods produce a question, not a proposal

tierRules.when: a deterministic approved rule names the target account and department
the target follows from judgement about the transaction
